_comment: TEMPLATE ONLY -- this file carries NO digests and is not usable by the gate.
The real list lives OUTSIDE the repository: NCZ_SECRET_HASHES_FILE, else ~/.config/ncz/secret-hashes.json.
Generate it on a TRUSTED machine, never on a build host:
Then copy that output file to ~/.config/ncz/secret-hashes.json and its key (0600) to
~/.config/ncz/secret-hashes.key on the build host, or point NCZ_SECRET_HASHES_FILE / NCZ_SECRET_HASHES_KEY at them.  The build-image secret-scan stage fails
closed when the file is absent (NCZ_SECRET_SCAN=skip records SKIP and the image is never archived), so a build host can never silently skip
the hashed half of the gate.
Key-master input (kept off every build host):
key_id: <fingerprint of the 0600 key file make-secret-hashes.py used>
